question.text: In a face centred cubic lattice, atoms of A form the corner points and atoms of B form the face centred points. If two atoms of $\mathrm{A}$ are missing from the corner points, the formula of the ionic compound is :

solution.text:
A form corner points and two atoms of A are missing from corner
$$
\begin{aligned}
\therefore \quad & \text { Atoms at corner }(\mathrm{A})=6 \times \frac{1}{8}=\frac{3}{4} \\
& \text { Atoms at face centre }(\mathrm{B})=6 \times \frac{1}{2}=3 \\
\therefore & \mathrm{A}_{3 / 4} \mathrm{~B}_3 \text { i.e., } \mathrm{AB}_4
\end{aligned}
$$
